correctness.rationale: Disconnected induced triples are precisely triples with 0 or 1 edges. For n<=12 none exist. For each 13<=n<=20, independently enumerated every face of Alexander dual, all mod-two augmented boundary ranks, and Euler–Poincare; its unique reduced groups have degree/rank 13:5/1, 14:5/1, 15:3/21, 16:3/101, 17:3/52, 18:3/19, 19:3/1, 20:2/4, transferring to homology below the dimension n-4 and obstructing pure shellability. For n=21..26, the actual shelling_orders.json blob SHA 780888bf06c65163d70d09fcb2e2a210c2997220 was fetched and independently checked for every facet-permutation entry and EVERY earlier-facet intersection: facet counts 805,990,1196,1424,1675,1950; spanning counts 1,12,24,37,51,66; total 5,843,201 pair comparisons. The exact codimension-one criterion establishes all six shellings and integral wedges, not mere finite sampling. For n>=27, use Chauhan–Shukla Theorem 1.4 (n>=6p-3 with p=5). The prior table of Betti numbers is not a new result.
